name: AI Risk Management: Riskledge
subtitle: Risk, policy, vendors, audit
shortDescription: Learn to run AI governance at work: registers, risk scores, vendor checks, policies and board reports. Labs, quizzes, sources. Not legal advice.
longDescription:
Riskledge teaches managers how to get work done with AI responsibly. Follow a fictional company, Harbourline Logistics, through ten folders: accountability and roles, the AI register, risk scoring, the NIST AI Risk Management Framework, the EU AI Act, management systems, privacy questions, vendor checks, policies and incidents, and the one-page board report.

Learn by doing. Every folder has a work scenario and hands-on labs: build a RACI sheet, fill an AI register, find shadow AI in an expense list, move a control slider and watch the risk move on a heat map, sort activities into the framework functions, size a review sample, score vendors, test a pilot against its threshold, and watch an override-rate chart for a real alarm. Each lab ends with a question computed from what you built, and every equation is shown next to the situation it describes.

Honest and checkable. Every statement carries a source record you can open in a full-width sheet, with the stored record available offline. Dated cards say what to verify. The EU AI Act dates were read from the Official Journal texts on 2026-11-17, including the 2026 amendment, and the app tells you to check the current text.

What you get:
- 10 folders, 21 labs, 190 questions plus a 20-question mixed check
- Short sessions, a gentle replay of missed questions, no streak pressure
- Sources from NIST, EU institutions, regulators, universities and standards bodies, with links verified on 2026-11-17
- Text size from 85% to 200%, VoiceOver labels, works offline, no account

Free with ads. An optional monthly subscription ($3.99 per month after a 7-day free trial) only removes ads; you can also watch an optional video for a credit. Cancel anytime in your account settings; cancellation takes effect at the next billing cycle.

For adults (18+). Riskledge gives no legal advice and does not certify compliance with any law or standard. All organisations and people are fictional; numbers in labs are illustrative unless a source is cited. Content as of 2026-11-17.
